contexts.text: He thought of a Spirit as being a spectre, SE 3890.
Believed that men after death would be like phantoms, in which opinion they had confirmed themselves by the spectres of which they had heard.
The delight (of these Genii) is to render themselves invisible, and fly around others like phantoms... DP 310:4. CL 514:3. DMin 4784.
Like one who sees spectres in a shadow.
Truths then can be seen only like spectres in the night time.
Who thinks that (his dead wife and children) are spectres?
Faith without charity is a phantom.

He had said... If anything of man lives after death, must it not be like a spectre? How can a spectre eat and drink, etc... Spectres, which are aerial effigies, appear as if they are, and yet are not.
Thence conceive chimeras, and bring forth spectres.
The natural man regards spiritual things as spectres and phantasms in the air. TCR 381.
The fourth said... when a man has died, he becomes a spectre and is dissipated...
Like one who sees spectres in bed when he awakes.
On awakening in the twilight, I once saw spectres in various shapes. Explained.
May be likened to the aerial man who is called a spectre, such as Fame was depicted...
There is then faith no longer, but only the ghost of faith...
(Such a man would be) like a spectre standing; in vision...
In a mausoleum, where there are... spectres of the night flying beneath the roof.
She appeared pendulous, like a kind of spectre.
The profane... become like spectres, and seem to themselves to fly in the air...
Their sincerity and rectitude are only a spectre...
The notion that man after death is... an unformed spectre of ether.
